job.job_description:
Job Summary




We are looking for a skilled AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Agentic AI, Voice Bots, Chatbots, Azure AI Foundry, API integrations, and AI orchestration. The role involves building intelligent automation solutions that enhance customer and employee experiences.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered Voice Bots and Chatbots using modern AI frameworks.
Build and manage Agentic AI workflows capable of autonomous task execution.
Develop AI solutions using Azure AI Foundry and related Azure AI services.
Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems through REST APIs and third-party services.
Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements and translate them into AI solutions.
Optimize conversational flows, prompt engineering, and AI model performance.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve AI applications in production.
Work closely with vendors and internal stakeholders to deliver scalable AI solutions.



Required Skills

Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, AI Voice Bots, and Chatbot platforms.
Strong experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI ecosystem.
Good understanding of REST APIs, API integration, authentication, and webhooks.
Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications.
Knowledge of prompt engineering, LLMs, and conversational AI design.
Understanding of AI governance, security, and responsible AI practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Good to Have

Programming experience in Python, or similar languages.
Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Power Automate.
Knowledge of vector databases, RAG architecture, and AI orchestration frameworks.
Experience with speech technologies (Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech).

Preferred Experience

37 years of experience in AI, Machine Learning, or Conversational AI.
Experience delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions.
Exposure to Campaign Management platforms and customer engagement workflows is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology,
